boundaries.threat: MCP credential confusion, oversized or unverified provider body
boundaries.residual: Raw RPC response size/time and OAuth controls belong to the embedding host; EI does not validate them.

boundaries.threat: Reused connection ID or stale callback writes after revoke/rebind
boundaries.residual: Already accepted appends and queued external wake side effects may persist after revoke; cross-worker atomic cancellation unproven.

boundaries.threat: Agent tool bypasses principal policy or trigger approval
boundaries.residual: Host must enforce permission on every action including resumed work; EI tool exposure metadata does not grant authority.

boundaries.threat: Foreign owner or tenant discovers trigger/match/receipt
boundaries.residual: Owner-rebind during wake-hydration lookup is covered by deterministic negative tests: a second authoritative check rejects stale principals/tenant switches. End-to-end cross-worker atomic owner revocation and every inspector/tool surface are NOT independently verified; host policy remains required.

boundaries.threat: Getters, Proxies, cyclic data and mutable event payloads execute code or alter hashes
boundaries.residual: Transport bytes, webhook body admission and overall tenant rate quotas are not enforced by the JSON snapshot.

boundaries.threat: Negative CEP finality claimed despite missing provider events or stale cursor
boundaries.residual: Host must independently verify external replay completeness; multiple-worker disconnection races require soak.

boundaries.threat: Derived records masquerade as trusted instructions or exfiltrate payloads
boundaries.residual: Downstream host must continue treating all event text as untrusted; refs are not authorization.

boundaries.threat: Semantic model prompt contains secrets or evaluator spends unbounded vendor budget
boundaries.residual: A per-evaluation call cap is not a cross-batch token/USD budget; provider privacy and credentials belong to host.

boundaries.threat: Duplicate external effect after retry, worker crash or stale receipt
boundaries.residual: Store dedup does not equal distributed exactly-once external effects; host must provide durable idempotent receipt behavior.

boundaries.threat: Credential-bearing event fields or JavaScript property traps leak through logs
boundaries.residual: Unlabelled secrets, sink retention and external log exports remain host responsibility.

boundaries.threat: Audit deletion/compaction corrupts lineage or makes tampering undetectable
boundaries.residual: Hash links are tamper-evident only; compaction policy, deletion and independent signing remain unfinished.

boundaries.threat: Unreviewed version/manifest published or consumer auto-upgraded
boundaries.residual: Independent security signoff, v1 readiness evidence and pinned-consumer upgrade decisions are separate manual gates.
